about: Frozen live-run defects. Each case calls one pure function and states what must stay true, so a newer change cannot silently undo an older fix, and a fix made in one module is held in its siblings. Add a case whenever a live run exposes a defect (CLAUDE.md). Run: py -m scripts.ops regressions [--file path].
